## Question and scope

State the precise question, assumptions, and success or stopping criterion.
You do not need a new bound or complete proof to open this issue.

## Existing work and first step

Link relevant notes, source commits, and related issues or PRs. Give a feasible
first step and blockers. Check the research index and open work for overlap.

## Evidence or handoff

If you have a result, distinguish the proof, finite checks, and remaining gaps.
Include reproduction commands and credit. For substantial work, link your claim
on the discussion board: https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-factoring/discussions/51
